en.text:
Linearly grants up to 80% increased damage as the beam is charged to 100% power.

Beam Energy is generated in two ways:
• Dealing damage grants 40% energy over 1 second. Initially has a 0.267 second delay before this starts granting energy.
• Collecting an <arc/>Ionic Trace grants 50% energy over 0.5 seconds

Not generating energy for 1.05 seconds rapidly cools the weapon down to 0% over 0.2 seconds.

Reaching maximum energy grants 100 Stability and 100 Reload Speed.
